items.title: Two re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran intelligence after RAF Fairford incident
items.summary: The head of UK Counter Terrorism Policing said they consider Iranian state involvement "highly likely".

items.title: Two men re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran after RAF Fairford incident
items.summary: Two men have been re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran’s intelligence service over a suspected terror plot near RAF Fairford.

items.title: Google resolves cloud outage affecting UK banks and websites
items.summary: Revolut was one of the hardest hit, with banking services going down for many customers.

items.title: Controversial Jackdaw gas field expected to be approved
items.summary: The controversial Jackdaw gas field is expected to receive approval from energy secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh on Wednesday.

items.title: BBC Three, BBC Scotland and Radio 4 Extra broadcast channels to close
items.summary: The closures are announced as the corporation continues to try to save £500m over two years.

items.title: Neglect in hospital contributed to baby's meningitis death, jury rules
items.summary: Neglect contributed to the death of a five-month-old girl who died from meningitis after opportunities were missed in hospital to save or prolong her life, an inquest jury has found.
